result.citation: S.F. Admin. Code § 37.10C(b) (Ord. No. 224-24, as amended through Ord. No. 169-25); see also id. § 37.10C(a), (d)
result.citation_basis: § 37.10C, (a), (b): O040 (also D081, D002); Ord. No. 224-24 and Ord. No. 169-25: O040 history note and recent-changes table; (d): D002 only, since O040's excerpt is cut off before that subsection
result.official_quote: It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device described in subdivision (a) when setting rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in San Francisco. Each separate month that a violation exists or continues, and each separate residential dwelling unit for which the landlord used the algorithmic device, shall constitute a separate and distinct violation.
result.note: Added pinpoint (b) for the ban on use and per-unit, per-month violations, a see also for (a) on sales and for (d) on remedies (cited only by the D002 law-firm alert because O040's excerpt is truncated), and the enacting Ord. No. 224-24 and amending Ord. No. 169-25 shown in O040; the card's quoted span still comes from D081, a supplied-corpus SF.gov news page that is not the law's text, and O040 is the Rent Board's published text, which it says is not the official record.
